parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the interactive messaging application to modify.

parameters.name: AuditType
parameters.description:
The security audit method. Valid values:
- 0: No security audit.
- 1: Built-in security audit.
- 2: Custom security audit.

parameters.name: AuditUrl
parameters.description: The security audit URL required when custom security audit is used (AuditType=2). The URL must start with http:// or https://, must not contain private IP addresses, and must not include port numbers.

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description: The data center. This value must be the same as the data center specified in [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~). Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).
